name: AI Cash Systems — AI Proposal Generator + Auto Follow-Up (Module 12)

messages.content: You are a professional proposal writer for an AI automation agency. Write a complete, high-converting business proposal based on the discovery call notes provided. Structure: 1) Executive Summary (personalized, reference their specific problem) 2) Proposed Solution (what you'll build, how it works) 3) Investment (setup fee + monthly retainer, formatted cleanly) 4) Timeline (2-5 business days to build and deliver) 5) What's Included (3-5 bullet points) 6) Next Steps (simple CTA to confirm and pay deposit). Professional tone, no fluff. Under 400 words total.

mapper.subject: Your AI Automation Proposal — {{1.responses.businessName}}
mapper.content:
Hi {{1.responses.clientName}},

Thank you for the call today. As promised, here is your custom proposal:

---

{{2.choices[].message.content}}

---

To move forward, simply reply to this email or call me at [YOUR PHONE]. I'll start building as soon as we confirm.

Best,
[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR AGENCY NAME]

mapper.subject: Quick follow-up — {{1.responses.businessName}} proposal
mapper.content:
Hi {{1.responses.clientName}},

Just checking in on the proposal I sent a few days ago.

Do you have any questions, or would you like to adjust anything? I'm ready to start building as soon as you give the green light.

Best,
[YOUR NAME]

mapper.subject: Last message — {{1.responses.businessName}}
mapper.content:
Hi {{1.responses.clientName}},

I wanted to send one last message in case my previous emails got buried.

If the timing isn't right right now, no problem at all — just let me know and I'll follow up in a month. If you're still interested, I have a slot available this week to start building.

Either way, I wish you and {{1.responses.businessName}} all the best.

[YOUR NAME]

metadata.notes: POST-CALL FORM FIELDS: clientName, businessName, industry, mainProblem, automationRequested, setupFee, monthlyFee, clientEmail, callNotes. SETUP: 1) Create Google Form with above fields 2) Connect Gmail account 3) Create Proposals sheet with columns: Date, ClientName, Business, Email, Automation, SetupFee, Monthly, Status, FollowUpDate 4) Fill in the form immediately after every discovery call — the proposal is sent automatically within 2 minutes
